description: This PHP source file defines the view class for displaying details of a Scheduled Job (Scheduler) in a SuiteCRM module. It extends a base view class, manages the display of scheduled task information, and includes security checks and documentation headers.

classes.name: SchedulersViewDetail
classes.description: A class for rendering detailed views of scheduler entries, extending the base ViewDetail class and customizing the display of interval and user information.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleListParam
methods.description: Generates the HTML link for the module title in the browser tab, using localized module string.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares the scheduler bean for display by parsing its interval, setting human-readable interval, and assigning creator/modifier user names before calling the parent display method.
